name: arch-crew
description: A suite of architectural-decision skills for Claude Code: decide-architecture (software architecture stack), design-patterns (GoF + Python-idiomatic patterns), agentic-patterns (LLM-agent control-flow design), and test-patterns (risk-led testing portfolio across QA practice, unit / integration / end-to-end tests, and data / ML / LLM evaluation). Each skill branches on project status — greenfield runs a short selection interview and recommends a composed design; refactoring reviews existing code against the catalog and proposes targeted moves.
